title: Witch on the Holy Night: Witch Records
description: Here lies the records of the irreplaceable time they shared. Those unforgettable days where magic and youth intertwined. Aozaki Aoko, Kuonji Alice, Shizuki Soujuurou. Within the time they spent together lay countless moments left untold in the main story. Casual everyday lives, unforgettable encounters, and the quiet feelings lingering in each of their hearts. Witch Records—chronicling the many small stories woven throughout Misaki Town.
author: Type-Moon
